title: Show progress by region
description: Add a per-region progress breakdown to the dashboard so the user can see how far through each region of the Trail 100 they are. Regions come from the existing data/peaks.json; do not add or rename regions.
acceptanceCriteria: The dashboard shows one entry per region found in data/peaks.json, sorted alphabetically
Each region entry shows the region name, completed / total peaks, and a completion percentage
Each region entry has an accessible progress indicator (role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and an accessible name)
Region progress updates immediately when a peak is marked or unmarked complete, without a page reload
The per-region calculation is a pure function in src/peak-utils.js with automated tests, including a region with zero completed peaks and a fully completed region
The region breakdown is readable on a 360px-wide mobile screen and on desktop
Existing functionality and tests keep passing, and npm test exits with code 0
